content.text:
If no response is currently available to the GET_COMID_RESPONSE command, "No Response
Available" is returned.  "No Response Available" is defined in Table 31.

tables.title: Table 31 No Response Available
tables.table_md:
| BYTES | FIELD | VALUE |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 0 to 3 | Extended ComID | Allocated ComID |
| 4 to 7 | Request Code | 00 00 00 00 |
| 8 to 9 | Reserved | 00 00 |
| 10 to 11 | Available Data Length in bytes | 00 00 |
| 12 to TRNSFLEN - 1 | Reserved | 00 |
